vector_memory.semantic_summary: SequencerClock manages the precise timing and scheduling of events for an audio sequence, acting as a core timing service. It calculates step durations based on BPM and ticks-per-beat, utilizing the AudioContext for accurate time tracking. The component delegates periodic ticking to a Web Worker to maintain responsiveness, scheduling ahead based on a defined lookahead window.
